meta.name: Castle Clash Duel - Asset Packs Index
meta.description: Top-level index of every asset pack under public/assets/. Each pack has its own index.json with the actual texture/frame/animation data - this file just points to them so a Phaser game knows what's available and where.

packs.name: Tiny Swords
packs.description: Curated Tiny Swords pack actively loaded and animated by public/index.html - the canonical, verified manifest for the shipping game.

packs.name: RF Catacombs
packs.description: Free dungeon/catacombs tileset and candle/torch/spike animations. Not yet wired into any scene.

packs.name: UI Bundle Free
packs.description: Eight themed UI mockup sheets (casino, medieval, horror, generic fantasy, pastel, demo, fantasy, cozy). Not yet wired into any scene.

packs.name: Pixelole Overworld Tileset
packs.description: Single overworld terrain/object tileset sheet. Not yet wired into any scene.

packs.name: Unsorted VFX Pack
packs.description: 126 particle/VFX spritesheets (explosions, splashes, magic effects) from an unidentified source, each a 64x64-cell grid of 9 color variants x N animation frames. Not yet wired into any scene.
